_comment: Hand labels for the reply the customer gets and for R's drafts, keyed by '<question>|<SHA-256 of the exact text>', with the rules in data/evaluation.json (answer_label) and data/questions.json (grading.answer_labels). A text that appears in several conversations has one label. 'source' says where a label comes from: imported from Article #24's hand labels when the text is byte-identical to one of its agent A replies, or labeled by hand here.
